paite: “Huan kuapeuh in TOUPA kiang a thillat, tangbuang thillat alat chiang in, athillat tangbuang nel dimdem ahi ding ahi. Sathau abuak dia, atung ah begaw akoih lai ding ahi”.
heading: Tangbuang Thillatte
english: “‘When anyone offers an offering of a meal offering to Yahweh, his offering shall be of fine flour. He shall pour oil on it, and put frankincense on it.

paite: Aaron tapa siampute kiang ah apaipih dia; ama'n apham khat in huai a tangbuang nel dimdem, asathau toh, abegaw tengteng toh alakhe ding a, siampu in maitam tung ah theihgigena, TOUPA a dia gimlimtak, mei a thillat ding in ahal ding hi.
english: He shall bring it to Aaron’s sons, the priests. He shall take his handful of its fine flour, and of its oil, with all its frankincense, and the priest shall burn its memorial on the altar, an offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to Yahweh.

paite: Tangbuang thillat bangte Aaron leh atapate a ding ahi ding. Huai TOUPA a dia mei a thillatte a thil siangthoupen ahi.
english: That which is left of the meal offering shall be Aaron’s and his sons’. It is a most holy part of the offerings of Yahweh made by fire.

paite: “Tangbuang thillat, akanna a kan thillat na latleh, tangbuang nel dimdem, sathau a mek silngou soh louh tanghou hiam, sathau a zut, silngou soh louh tanghou pei hiam ahi ding ahi”.
english: “‘When you offer an offering of a meal offering baked in the oven, it shall be unleavened cakes of fine flour mixed with oil, or unleavened wafers anointed with oil.

paite: “Na thillat, kuang a kan tangbuang thillat ahihleh, silngou soh louh, sathau a mek, tangbuang nel dimdem ahi ding hi”.
english: If your offering is a meal offering made on a griddle, it shall be of unleavened fine flour, mixed with oil.

paite: Na phelkhap ding a, sathau a na buah ding ahi. Huai tangbuang thillat ahi.
english: You shall cut it in pieces, and pour oil on it. It is a meal offering.

paite: “Na thillat kan bel a kan, tang- buang thillat ahihleh tangbuang nel dimdem leh sathau a bawl ahi ding hi”.
english: If your offering is a meal offering of the pan, it shall be made of fine flour with oil.

paite: Hiai thil a bawl tangbuang thillat TOUPA kiang ah na hon tawi dia; siampu kiang a lat ahi dia, ama'n maitam ah hon paipih ding hi.
english: You shall bring the meal offering that is made of these things to Yahweh. It shall be presented to the priest, and he shall bring it to the altar.

paite: Siampu in tangbuang thillat a pan theihgigena pen alakhe dia, maitam ah ahal ding. Hiai TOUPA a dia gimlimtak, mei a thillat ahi.
english: The priest shall take from the meal offering its memorial, and shall burn it on the altar, an offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to Yahweh.

paite: Tangbuang thillat lat bangte Aaron leh atapate atuam ding ahi dia; hiai TOUPA a dia mei a thillatte lak a siangthoupen ahi.
english: That which is left of the meal offering shall be Aaron’s and his sons’. It is a most holy part of the offerings of Yahweh made by fire.

paite: "Tangbuang thillat himhim, TOUPA kiang a na lat ding uh silngou soh a bawl ding ahi kei. TOUPA a dia mei a thillat ah silngou hiam, khuaizu himhim na hel ding uh ahi kei”.
english: “‘No meal offering which you shall offer to Yahweh shall be made with yeast; for you shall burn no yeast, nor any honey, as an offering made by fire to Yahweh.

paite: Gah masapen thillat bang in TOUPA kiang ah na lan ding ua; gimlim dia maitam akoih ding ahi kei hi.
english: As an offering of first fruits you shall offer them to Yahweh, but they shall not rise up as a pleasant aroma on the altar.

paite: Na tangbuang thillat ah na Pathian thukhun chi na maih ding ahi kei. Na thillat tengteng ah chi na lat tel ding ahi.
english: Every offering of your meal offering you shall season with salt. You shall not allow the salt of the covenant of your God to be lacking from your meal offering. With all your offerings you shall offer salt.

paite: Gah masapen tangbuang thillat TOUPA kiang a na latleh na buh thak masapente, tangbuang thillat ding in tanghou pek na lan ding ahi.
english: “‘If you offer a meal offering of first fruits to Yahweh, you shall offer for the meal offering of your first fruits fresh heads of grain parched with fire and crushed.

paite: Sathau na buak dia, atung ah begaw na koih ding ahi,
english: You shall put oil on it and lay frankincense on it. It is a meal offering.

paite: siampu in huai theihgigena, buh sukzan bangzah hiam toh begaw tengteng toh ahal ding ahi. Hiai TOUPA a dia amei a thillat ahi.
english: The priest shall burn as its memorial part of its crushed grain and part of its oil, along with all its frankincense. It is an offering made by fire to Yahweh.
